text:
raj: quick ask — seeing ~30% p50 bump on batch=4 seq=1k for gpt-j-6B-q8 in main. can someone grab an nsys + torch.profiler trace and share scrubbed artifacts? link: https://perf.redwood.dev/runs/1223 (private)

anna: ah thanks. which commit + instance? also is this reproducing on dedicated rigs?

raj: commit 9f2a3b7 (serving/runtime perf fixes). repro on A100-40G and A6000-48GB. pref on A6000. payload: batch=4 seq=1024 context varied.

kevin: I can run on A6000 later today. can you paste the nsys + torchprof flags you want? also how big can trace be (we hit 10GB limit last time)

raj: prefer sample=none, but capture full kernel timeline + nvtx. use --capture-range=thread:start,end and limit to 30s. torch.profiler minimal: record_function + stack, but only for first warmup minibatch. scrub before upload. example:

```bash
export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0
nsys profile --output=/tmp/trace --capture-range=thread:StartProfiling,StopProfiling \
  --trace=cuda,cublas,cudnn,nvtx --sample=none --force-overwrite --follow-fork-children \
  --capture-start 0 --cpuctxsw=true --duration=30s \
  python -m myserving.benchmark --model gpt-j-6B-q8 --batch 4 --seq 1024
```

and in-model profiler snippet:

```py
with torch.profiler.profile(activities=[ProfilerActivity.CPU, ProfilerActivity.CUDA],
    schedule=torch.profiler.schedule(wait=1, warmup=1, active=3),
    record_shapes=True, with_stack=True, profile_memory=False,
    on_trace_ready=torch.profiler.tensorboard_trace_handler('/tmp/tb')) as prof:
  for i, batch in enumerate(batches):
    model(batch)
    prof.step()
```

kevin: perfect. I'll cap nsys output with `nsys export` to `.qdrep` and then `nsys stats --report=flamegraph` before upload. where to put uploads? S3 or perf box?

anna: use s3://redwood-perf/incoming/2338000123/ and prefix with your name. scrub secrets: replace bucket names, ip, user ids. remove any full prompt text.

kevin: got it. FYI I'll also run a "prefix-kv warmup disabled" variant to check kvcache misses. that'll help isolate prefetch regressions.

perf-bot: Automated: artifact size limit is 20GB. For >5GB please attach a short summary with top-5 kernels and sample flamegraph screenshot.

raj: thanks. if kevin sees big nvlink stalls call out `cudaMemcpyPeer` times and tag with nvlink node id. ping me w/ link and I'll do a quick diff vs golden.

kevin: on it — will upload later and paste the S3 path. :thumbsup:

anna: cheers. also add `--torchscript=off` run to rule out jit differences.

kevin: noted.
